verdict.rationale: The API docs say the model returns the transcript along with the detected languages as JSON. The README describes Whisper as performing language identification and exposes `whisper.detect_language()`. CLI and Python examples transcribe without declaring a language, and specifying one is presented as optional ("you can specify the language"). missing for 10: an explicit statement that language is auto-detected by default when omitted, and independent hands-on corroboration of auto-detection accuracy.
